candidate_evidence.quote: Local, targeted therapy with alpha emitter \[225Ac\]Ac-DOTA-SP (TAT) administered to the post-resection cavity or tumour via Rickham reservoir using induced diffusion.

coder_notes: Registered phase NA (excluded at S3 by script) but coded fully. Radiopharmaceutical registered as Radiation; moiety per W1 is the ligand without isotope (dota-sp, a DOTA-conjugated substance P derivative), isotope 225Ac in drug_class_hint. Delivered intracavitary via Rickham reservoir catheter: coded new_route; device_dependent false since the catheter is a route rather than device activation (adjudicator may differ). Chemotherapy 'may be continued' per oncologist (optional, not listed); regimen coded monotherapy. Diagnostic 68Ga agents, mannitol/dexamethasone premedication and intracavitary saline (stated purpose: forced diffusion) listed for transparency; IV NaCl premedication not listed separately. Quantitative SPECT/CT of radiopharmaceutical distribution in the cavity/brain coded as tumour PK yes. NK-1 receptor expression appears only as rationale, not a requirement or planned measurement; no biomarkers. Primary endpoint per outcomes is clinical progression, though description says OS.
